integrity: The statement is proved by an explicit two-dimensional operator-space witness and exact interpolation bounds. No numerical experiment is used as proof. Direct source comparison and targeted implication searches were performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof does not cover the remaining parameter square \(1\le p,q<2\), and it does not classify the von Neumann--Jordan constant there.
title: Maximal von Neumann--Jordan constant for injective \(\ell_p\)-tensor products when one exponent is at least \(2\)
